global_parameters.lambda: <float> Weight applied to total line cost in the objective, with (1 - lambda) applied to total passenger travel time.
global_parameters.fixed_cost_per_line: <float> Fixed cost incurred for establishing any transit line.
global_parameters.operating_cost_per_edge: <float> Cost per unit frequency for operating a line over one edge.
global_parameters.max_line_length_edges: <int> Maximum number of edges allowed in any single transit line.
global_parameters.frequency_upper_bound_F: <float> Global upper bound on the frequency assigned to any individual line.
global_parameters.traveling_times_unit: <str> Unit of measurement for all edge traveling times.
global_parameters.coordinates_unit: <str> Unit of measurement for node coordinates and edge lengths.

network.num_nodes: <int> Total number of stations (nodes) in the transit network.
network.num_edges: <int> Total number of undirected edges connecting stations in the network.
network.num_od_nodes: <int> Number of stations that serve as origins or destinations for passenger demand.
network.area_km: <float> Side length of the square area containing the network.

nodes.is_od_node: <bool> Whether this station can be an origin or destination for passenger trips.

edges.endpoints: <list[int], length 2> Pair of node identifiers connected by this edge.
edges.traveling_time_seconds: <float> Time required to traverse this edge.
edges.edge_capacity: <float> Maximum total frequency of all lines that may use this edge.
edges.operating_cost: <float> Per-unit-frequency cost of operating a line over this edge.

modes.name: <str> Name of this transportation mode.
modes.vehicle_capacity: <int> Number of passengers a single vehicle run of this mode can carry.
modes.speed_kmh: <float> Travel speed of vehicles operating in this mode.
modes.fixed_cost_per_line: <float> Fixed cost for establishing a line of this mode.
modes.operating_cost_per_edge: <float> Per-unit-frequency cost for each edge traversed by a line of this mode.
modes.terminals: <list[int], length num_terminals> Node identifiers where lines of this mode may begin or end.
modes.edge_indices: <list[int], length num_edges> Indices of edges available to lines of this mode.
modes.num_edges: <int> Number of edges in the subnetwork for this mode.
modes.num_terminals: <int> Number of terminal stations for this mode.

od_matrix.origin: <int> Node identifier of the trip origin.
od_matrix.destination: <int> Node identifier of the trip destination.
od_matrix.demand: <int> Number of passengers wishing to travel from the origin to the destination.

od_summary.num_od_pairs: <int> Total number of origin-destination pairs with positive demand.
od_summary.total_demand: <int> Sum of passenger demand across all origin-destination pairs.
od_summary.num_od_nodes: <int> Number of distinct stations appearing as origins or destinations.
